consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the June 9, 1994 show at Cal Expo was a solid performance, showcasing the band's consistent musicianship despite not being one of their all-time best shows. Highlights included strong renditions of several songs, with particular praise for the emotional delivery of 'Stella Blue' and the energetic 'China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider.'
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 7 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the performance and highlighted specific songs, there were also criticisms regarding the overall impact of the show, leading to a mixed sentiment.
